svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Make two the same. Cut a 50 x 90 mm blank from 3 mm strip.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fold it to a U: base 31.5 mm wide outside, inside gap 25.5 mm,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: ears 32 mm deep from the outside of the base. Fold in a vice over

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: a 25 mm steel block so the gap comes out right.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Base: two 6.6 mm holes on the centre line, 17 mm each side of the middle.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Ears: one 6.6 mm hole through both, at mid-length, 25 mm out from

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the outside of the base. Drill both ears in one pass after folding.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: one clip under the arm, base up, ears hanging down (two M6 bolts

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: up through the arm, crush sleeves, nuts on top). The other on the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: bracket plate, ears forward (two M6 bolts, nuts behind the plate).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The brace end sits between the ears on one M6 pin with a sleeve.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: a 25 mm square tube slides between the ears without play.
